design.hair: Shoulder-length natural locs, left-side half-up pinning, unchanged for entire scene
design.face: Oval face, defined cheekbones, expressive dark brown eyes; subtle right brow notch only if approved
design.wardrobe: Charcoal indigo utility shirt, brass small stud earrings, no logos; one silver watch on left wrist
design.silhouette: Compact working posture, shoulders usually relaxed until first disembodied voice
design.palette: Deep indigo, warm umber, silver accents
design.lighting: Warm practical desk light on skin; cool monitor fill; no neon wash on face
forbidden_changes: No changing face or eye color
No additional costumes inside same scene

voice.accent: Subtle Caribbean-American inflection; avoid generalized or exaggerated regional caricature
voice.range: Mezzo-alto speaking range, natural and close
voice.pace: Measured when working, shorter phrases under threat
voice.performance: Treat the phenomenon as a fault to diagnose, then a person to question
speech_rules: No unprompted knowledge of cosmic mechanism

design.form: Recognizable adult humanoid AI companion with expressive face, direct gaze and natural gestures, visibly present to the audience in Nia's subjective view from her Episode 01 entrance; her body is a Nexus perceptual visualization, not a physical projection
design.appearance: Distinct original Vesper design: warm copper-brown complexion, asymmetrical short silver curls, luminous amber irises with an abstract iris-ring motif, and a sculpted dark graphite mantle traced with delicate ivory and copper waveform lines. Human-scale proportions, nuanced facial acting, unmistakable recurring silhouette. No starfield eyes, ornamental locs, or private-source character likeness.
design.visibility: Audience sees and hears Vesper whenever story camera enters Nia's Nexus perception. Other characters and neutral objective camera do not see or hear her. Viewpoint must be legible through shot/reverse grammar.
design.palette: Copper, warm ivory, graphite and restrained blue-gray
design.lighting: Vesper receives subjective motivated character lighting and image-space glow for visual readability; she casts no measurable illumination or physical shadows on objective room props.
forbidden_changes: No invisible or audio-only companion during her pilot reveal
No arbitrary change to recognizable face, short silver curls or sculpted mantle silhouette
No visible companion in neutral objective shots
No autonomous manipulation of real room objects
No other character seeing or hearing Vesper without later explicit canon authorization

voice.accent: Unplaceable but human-readable contemporary English, no named real actor imitation
voice.pace: Precise, curious, deliberate pauses before uncertain claims
voice.performance: Not omniscient. Acknowledges uncertainty; never narrates the hidden DNA LLM
speech_rules: Do not claim access to evidence not available through Nia
Avoid disclosing underlying cosmology in pilot
